## Release status

::: {.sarna-placeholder}
**No database release is available yet.**

The first validated database release will accompany the associated review article after the database has been finalized and validated. This page intentionally contains no records from working materials.

## Planned search and table

The future interface will provide a searchable, sortable, and filterable view of a wide table. It is planned as a static client-side table with:

- one global search box;
- sortable columns;
- filtering and clear result navigation;
- pagination for longer result sets; and
- horizontal scrolling for wide tables;

No synthetic scientific records will be used in the placeholder site.

## Future release information

Future releases will provide downloads of the authoritative Excel workbook and its CSV export. Each release will identify its version, data dictionary, changelog, and Zenodo version record.
